'''Aaz'del Hutrick''' was the [[Director/Legends|director]] of the [[Imperial Department of Munitions Resource Development]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Vost Tyne]] was responsible for reporting the progress of the [[Dynamic Synergetics, Inc.]] [[Hyperbaride/Legends|hyperbaride]] [[DSI Hyperbaride Synthesis Plant|plant]] on [[Marca/Legends|Marca]] to Hutrick.
